name: pluma
description: Writing styles with a deterministic verifier: a library of voices (formal, warm, concise, persuasive, technical) and document forms (formal letter, professional email, speech, proposal, cover letter) as AgenC output styles — plus a prose linter that verifies every draft against its style's ruleset before delivery. The model writes; the linter judges.

escribe.description: Write with a chosen voice or full form, verified by a deterministic prose linter

interface.shortDescription: Every voice you need — and a linter that proves it.
interface.longDescription: A writing-styles library and its verifier. Ten curated styles ship as AgenC output styles — five voices (formal, cercano/warm, directo/concise, persuasivo, técnico) and five full forms (formal letter, professional email, speech, proposal, cover letter) — each defining structure, register and before/after examples, selectable session-wide with /output-style. The differentiator is the deterministic prose linter: every draft is verified against its style's ruleset — fillers, slang, hedges, vague quantities, contractions, exclamations and emoji, first-person opinion, passive-heavy prose, salutation/closing and required sections, length bands, readability (Fernández Huerta/Flesch family) — returning violations with excerpts and concrete fixes and a 0-100 score the draft must clear before delivery. Fully offline, zero dependencies, works the same on small local models: the style files carry the craft, the linter carries the guarantee.
